question: What is the meaning of (predictive) building circularity indicator in relation to performance indicators (an interpretation of the ce performance of a product)?
data_group: performance indicators (an interpretation of the ce performance of a product)
description: The Circularity Indicator (CI) is a performance indicator that assesses the level of circularity of a building between 0 and 100%. It measures "the extend to which linear flow has been minimised and restorative flow maximised for its component materials, and how long and intensively it is used compared to a similar industry-average product." This indicator is used to evaluate the performance of a product in relation to the CE principles, providing a score that reflects the building's circularity.
